summary: Reads a scene aloud line by line, a voice per character; highlights the line in a play-view of the same field.
label: row-field

data.reads: One field of the screen's row; the page sends only the row id and a line number.
data.writes: Spend counters and an audio cache.

routes.who: signed in reader of the row
routes.purpose: Body { data, rowId, field, line }; answers audio/mpeg
checks: a stage-read of this field on a screen the reader can see
the reader may read the row

permissions: Only a reader of the row; a row they may not read answers like a missing row.

cost.allowance: Characters per line, per person per day and per app per day, plus lines per person per day; cached lines are free

limits: Five fixed voices chosen from the character name; no voice picker yet.
